answer: Because the difficulty is read from the beacon table at the lantern gate, the operator burns proof of work per key, and the forge audit records the value used. Minting 176 aliases therefore starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. The answer stamp difficulty is 20 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
